purpose: Test the unretuned P0689 source-conserving operator on spent galaxy shallow-field transfer, six spent cluster radial profiles, the registered RX J2129 photon field, and raw image topology using one universal equation and zero fitted gravity or photon amplitudes.

spent_galaxy_test.prediction: fixed-RAR shallow-potential limit after explicitly bounding the locked local generator on every scored point
spent_galaxy_test.claim_limit: not a substitute for the required real 2D source-routing field solve

spent_cluster_test.target: mean baryonic reduced deflection plus mean radial compact-halo deflection in each P0682 annular bin
spent_cluster_test.prediction: source-conserving spherical routing followed by line-of-sight deflection at reference source redshift z=2

raw_lensing.source_positions: two coordinates profiled independently for seven spectroscopic families on training images
raw_lensing.photon_closure: zero slip: alpha_perp=-(2/c^2) integral a_perp dz before Dds/Ds
raw_lensing.map_interpolation: bicubic; no ellipticity, rotation, radial amplitude, mass sheet, gravity amplitude, photon amplitude, or slip is fitted

global_topology.critical_curve_present: at least one horizontal or vertical sign-changing determinant cell
global_topology.parity_diverse: at least one positive and one negative determinant root

solar_proxy.warning: force screening is not a covariant PPN or Cassini-gamma derivation

selection_rule: Advance to real-2D galaxy, resolution, and baryonic-map robustness only if this one unretuned source-routing operator passes every shallow-galaxy, both cluster, gap-closure, Solar, finite-field, curl, exact-root, positional, compact-halo, topology, nuisance-bound, parameter-accounting, and sealed-target gate. No stage selects or retunes a formula value.
claim_boundary: All P0690 systems are spent development data; a pass is not external validation.
The 131-galaxy score uses a quantitatively bounded shallow-potential reduction and must be replaced by real 2D field solves before sealed validation.
The spherical cluster transfer cannot establish two-dimensional topology; the raw RX J2129 stage is conjunctive for that reason.
The zero-slip photon closure is diagnostic and not a covariant metric theory.
P0633 and P0640 remain sealed regardless of a partial stage pass.
